blocks.text: Your care agents get one page per customer in Alepo CRM, with plans, billing, tickets and inventory together, and business processes are configurable steps with an assistant on the page.
Legacy telecom CRMs are heavy. Agents hunt across tools for a customer's history, and every process change touches code. Alepo's **telecom CRM software** puts that history in one place.

head: Fact
Detail
rows: Billing and charging, plus inventory. Self-care and Mobile POS. AI Agent Assist.
In your environment, on Kubernetes, with 24x7 support

blocks.text: Also known as: CRM, **customer care software**, CSR console, agent desktop, customer management, order management, trouble ticketing

sections.h2: Everything about a customer on one page

blocks.text: Agents stop hunting across tools. Plans, billing, tickets and inventory sit on one customer page.
The page connects to billing and charging systems and to inventory, as well as to self-care and Mobile POS.

sections.h2: Fewer process changes waiting on developers

blocks.text: Process changes rarely wait for developers. Business processes are built as configurable steps.
Most process changes are made in settings.

sections.h2: Answers in English, French and Arabic

blocks.text: An assistant on the customer page answers from the live account, in English, French and Arabic.
It explains a bill, a failure or a balance and suggests the next step.

AI Agent Assist (beta) is docked on the customer page. It answers from the live account with 14 read-only tools, so agents get the answer without hunting across screens. It sees only what the signed-in agent is allowed to see.
See how AI works across Alepo products →

items.a: A **telecom CRM** manages subscriber accounts, orders, tickets and interactions for an operator, and connects to billing, charging and the network so agents see the full picture.

items.q: Can we change processes without code?
items.a: Yes. Business processes are configurable steps, and most changes are made in settings.

items.q: Which languages does the AI assistant support?

blocks.text: Your team installs the new CRM in containers, one standard way, from the same automated guide as every Alepo product.

When something needs fixing, the patch goes only to the component affected, with rollback ready, so your maintenance window stays short. It runs on Kubernetes in your environment, operated by your team or by Alepo, with 24x7 support from GTAC.
